component.name: Tether
component.summary: Humane Flowmodoro, focus soundscapes, and cognitive companion for deep work

description.p: Tether is an unbreakable Flowmodoro timer, focus soundscape player, and cognitive companion designed for deep work, knowledge workers, creators, students, and professionals—crafted with universal design principles that empower neurodivergent minds (ADHD, Autism, Dyslexia) and anyone seeking calm, sustainable, guilt-free productivity.

Instead of rigid countdown alarms that shatter concentration, Tether counts UP to ride your natural flow state and calculates proportional rest periods when you finish. It includes offline acoustic focus soundscapes (Brown, Pink, Green noise, 40 Hz Gamma, and authentic nature field recordings), AI- and context-assisted RAM-dumps with full edit/delete history, an impulse parking buffer, time anchoring, an evening shutdown ritual, and universal context tracking across Obsidian, LibreOffice, PDF readers, creative tools, Neovim, and VS Code.
Daily focus persistence, automatic GitHub release update notifications, cross-platform window tracking, and full interactive WinUI 3 parity.

ul.li: Daily focus total persistence across sessions, timer resets, and system restarts in both core stats and FFI snapshots.
Automatic GitHub Releases version check at startup and every 6 hours with in-app banner, header pill, desktop notification, and Settings controls.
Cross-platform active window tracking supporting Hyprland, Sway/i3, Niri, X11, macOS, and Windows.
Full interactive WinUI 3 feature parity for RAM-dump, Impulses, Momentum, Rewards, and Settings (including auto-update controls).

description.p: Workspace automation & ecosystem parity release adding Global Quick-Capture, Shared Core CLI, Waybar module, and Obsidian tether-flow sync.

ul.li: Global Quick-Capture modal (tether --quick-capture, --impulse, --ramdump) for capturing thoughts, AI-assisted RAM-dumps, and 5-minute Micro-Starts from any window.
Shared Core CLI interface (tether --cli <operation> [payload]) exposing Flowmodoro control, impulses, RAM-dumps, and health checks.
Live Waybar JSON status module (tether --waybar) displaying focus/break timers, active context anchor, and open impulse counts.
Full synchronization with tether-flow (Obsidian Community Plugin) and upgraded tether-vscode extension.

description.p: Universal deep-work release introducing AI-assisted RAM-dumps, edit/delete CRUD, Phase 4 recovery workflows, and Obsidian support.

ul.li: Universal app integration & automatic window/file anchoring for Obsidian, Typora, LibreOffice, PDF/study readers (Sioyek, Evince, Zathura, Okular, Xournal++), image/design suites (GIMP, Krita, Inkscape, Darktable), video/3D/audio tools (Kdenlive, Omacut, Blender, Audacity, OBS), Neovim, and VS Code.
Non-blocking AI & context-assisted RAM-dump autofill supporting Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini, Codex, and Ollama with heuristic fallback.
Full RAM-dump history management to view, edit, and delete saved entries.
Evening Shutdown Ritual, "Where Was I?" absence recovery card, and Time Anchor hard-stop reminders.
First-class tether-obsidian plugin support and GPL-2.0 relicensing.

description.p: Feature release introducing Dopamine Account and Micro-Rewards (Dopaminkonto) for ADHD positive reinforcement.

ul.li: Live dopamine point accrual: 1 point per 5 minutes of active focus, +1 bonus for completing a 5-minute Micro-Start, and +1 bonus for parking an impulse or resisting a distraction.
Interactive Dopamine Menu (Dopaminmeny) with Hero Balance Card, categorized micro-reward tiers, custom reward creator, and one-click guilt-free redemption.
HeaderBar pill indicator and Flow tab momentum stat widget tracking live dopamine balance.
Dynamic GTK4 natural height measurement for the Flow tab to prevent vertical clipping or scrolling.

description.p: Major feature release introducing Fartsdump (Soft Interceptor) to protect ADHD deep flow.

ul.li: Real-time background distraction detection during active focus sessions.
Dedicated centered desktop prompt (org.tether.Speedbump) appearing directly on the active workspace.
Quick 1-key actions: "Parkér som impuls" (Enter) to auto-save rabbit holes and refocus editor, "Dette er relevant" (Esc) to snooze, and "Ta pause nå" to bank and take break.
Customizable distraction triggers list, cooldown duration, and master toggle in the Settings tab.

description.p: User interface polish, calm typography, and dedicated focus soundscape section.

ul.li: Added dedicated group header and description for the focus soundscape controls.
Replaced raw unicode emojis across buttons, headers, dialogs, and badges with clean, professional typography and symbolic vector icons in line with GNOME HIG and Calm Design.
Refined action button labels, context anchor rows, momentum tiers, and editor connection status indicators.

description.p: Feature release with focus soundscapes, volume popover, interactive checkboxes, retention cleanup, and platform-agnostic focus tracking.

ul.li: Procedural offline focus soundscapes (Brown noise, Pink noise, Gentle rain) with auto-play and fade-down.
Interactive in-row sound controls with play/pause toggle and flush-right volume popover.
Interactive markdown checkboxes for captured impulses with customizable retention pruning.
Platform-agnostic editor focus synchronization across Neovim, VS Code, and desktop.
Dynamic content-driven window sizing without vertical scrolling on the Flow tab.
Gentle focus chime and break gong notifications.

description.p: Added pause banking on early break termination, per-editor minimize settings, and auto-maximize on break.
Initial release of Tether desktop companion.
